shared_conventions.follows: The sb1 conventions in runs/p3-environment-sb1/result.json.shared_conventions are adopted unchanged: timeline_ref = story_time event id (story_timeline has no T-* ids); timeline_node = TL-003; waking_clock = real GMT time on the bank while the dream plays (not dream-internal time); a state is inferred:false only when its key values are stated in the source, and designed extras are listed in designed_fields.

wind.breeze: a steady, noticeable wind stronger than light_breeze; used only for the open treetop (geography LOC-pigeon-nest-treetop 'open and breezy') and the shore run (ch010-p80 'the breeze that followed them')

daylight_access (fixed per scene).smoke_filled_interior: interior filled with smoke; daylight only as a hazy shaft from the door or a small window (SCN-duchess-kitchen)
daylight_access (fixed per scene).high_windows: interior lit by tall windows set high in the walls; light shafts only, no sky view (SCN-courtroom). This respects geography.json LOC-courtroom 'sky: none'. The window form itself is for 05-scenes/architecture to confirm.

atmosphere (optional scene dim).stuffy_crowded: warm, close, crowded air with dust in the sunbeams

enum_extensions_sb2.alignment: 05-scenes/lighting uses time_of_day and weather as condition keys (ENV-ENUM-v1 values). The sb2 additions are wind and daylight_access values only. No new time_of_day or weather value was introduced.

waking_clock_mapping_sb2.anchors_from_sb1: ev0021 ends 16:25 (SCN-caterpillar-clearing S02); ev0032 hall at 17:36 (SCN-long-hall S03) and passage 17:36-17:38 (SCN-little-door-passage S02); waking ev0053 at 19:35 (SCN-riverbank S02).
waking_clock_mapping_sb2.method: ev0022-ev0052 are spread over 16:25-19:35 in event order, at about 6-7 minutes per event, fitted to the sb1 anchors. The sb1 rule '14:15 + (n-2) x 6.7 min' would put ev0052 at 19:50, after the 19:35 waking, so the tail is compressed to end exactly at 19:35. sb1's own anchors are kept as they are.
waking_clock_mapping_sb2.result: ev0022 treetop 16:25-16:30 (afternoon); Duchess house, kitchen, Cat's path, tea-party, wood and rose-tree 16:30-17:52 (late_afternoon); croquet 17:52-18:28 (late_afternoon); Gryphon 18:28-18:32 (late_afternoon); Mock Turtle's shore 18:32-18:56 (golden_hour); courtroom 18:56-19:35 (golden_hour), handing straight on to the waking at 19:35.
waking_clock_mapping_sb2.sun: Sun elevation and azimuth are computed for Oxford (51.75 N, 1.26 W) on 4 July (declination +22.9 deg, solar noon about 12:09 GMT).

shared_conventions.dream_growth_rule: Ruling 5.2 A: every card has fixed.dream_growth, which names the waking detail (the index grows_from / world.json counterpart) and how the dream's light and air grow from the real afternoon. Dream exteriors take the waking sun of their clock slot; interiors state how daylight gets in (or doesn't).

decisions: Every state is summer (35 of 35); weather is fair throughout. fair_hot runs to 18:32; fair_evening from the Mock Turtle's shore on; interiors are none_enclosed. There is no season or day-phase conflict with story_timeline (ev0022-ev0052 are all continuous T0, dream layer).

Tea-party: the Hatter's 'always six o'clock' (ch007-p57) is kept as the dream clock. The waking clock here is 17:14-17:33, so on 4 July both readings are late-afternoon light. The light is held steady across the four states to support the frozen tea-time.
Croquet's 'half an hour or so' (ch009-p36) is dream time; the waking clock gives the game about 32 minutes, which agrees.
The Queen 'frowning like a thunderstorm' (ch009-p30) is a simile: the sky stays clear. This is flagged in the card so video prompts do not add storm weather.
Golden hour starts at the Mock Turtle's shore (18:32). This fits 'Soup of the evening' (song lyric, ch010-p76) and the explicit following breeze (ch010-p80).

Courtroom S08 (ev0052): a draught through the windows lifts the flying pack. It is the dream form of the waking light_breeze that brings the dry leaves down in SCN-riverbank S02 (cp-cards-leaves, SUP-004). Wind steps from still to light_breeze only at this last state.

Seasonal guards (July): the rose-tree is in full bloom (peak season); old leaf-litter in the wood is normal but the canopy is fully green with no falling leaves before the waking; no spring blossom and no autumn colour anywhere.
The pepper in the courtroom (cook's pepper-box, ch011-p64) is a prop effect, not a room atmosphere change.
checked_not_conflicts: ch007-p48 / TL-004 'last March' (Hatter's quarrel): dream-internal backstory (UTQ-003 resolved). It is told, not staged, and does not touch the present season.
ch011-p12 'All on a summer day' (the accusation verse) agrees with the season.

geography.json LOC-courtroom 'sky: none -- an enclosed room' against the designed high windows: the windows show light shafts only, with no sky in view, so this is compatible. Flagged to architecture, not a defect.
geography.json LOC-rock-ledge 'warm, in full sun' against golden_hour: the sun is still up at 11-14 deg, so the ledge stays in direct sun. Compatible.

handoff.05-scenes/lighting: Key per state on time_of_day + weather (+ wind, daylight_access). Sun elevation/azimuth are given per exterior state. The kitchen and courtroom give diegetic_daylight descriptions only; setting the light itself is lighting's job.
handoff.06-art/environment-concept: Use fixed.ground_and_flora and seasonal_guard; the tea-party light is held steady across its states.
handoff.09-audio/ambience: Wind states: treetop breeze; shore light_breeze then breeze (song carried on it); courtroom draught at S08 only; everywhere else still.
